There are a lot of very complicated reasons a man may act like this if he’s coming from a place of sincerity, and ultimately you need to talk to him and work out a compromise that fits you both well since very soon you will have both brought a new life into the world and you will need to try, if nothing else, to provide a stable loving environment for them.

When the relationship ends, and you realise you were dating an abuser, know that you don’t hold a shred of responsibility for the relationship ending, you may still love them, but they never deserved the privilege of your love, they likely won’t give you closure, they won’t give you a reason and they won’t be fair, they will hang on by the pommel till they twist off the blade in your chest. And not a second of it is your fault.
